sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: BELT OF RELATIVELY STRONGER MID LEVEL FLOW WILL ARC AROUND THE DOMINANT CNTRL U.S. ANTICYCLONE FROM THE PAC NW ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS/UPR MS VLY THEN TAKE A TURN SEWD ACROSS THE TN VALLEY AND SOUTHEAST. SEVERAL SHORTWAVE DISTURBANCES EXIST WITHIN THIS FLOW STREAM...THE MOST AMPLIFIED OF WHICH WAS OVER MN/NRN WI THIS MORNING. THIS WAVE WILL DIG SEWD ACROSS THE GREAT LAKES THROUGH TONIGHT AND ACT TO MAINTAIN THE LARGER SCALE MEAN TROUGH ACROSS THE EAST. THE COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH THE GREAT LAKES SHORT WAVE DISTURBANCE WILL SPREAD SEWD ACROSS WI AND NRN MI THROUGH TONIGHT AND BE SITUATED FROM LAKE HURON SWWD ACROSS MI TO IA BY EARLY TUESDAY. WHILE THE COLD FRONT ACROSS THE GREAT LAKES AND MIDWEST WILL BE WELL DEFINED...MORE SUBTLE SFC AND UPPER AIR FEATURES EXISTS ON THE ERN FLANK OF THE ANTICYCLONE FROM THE LOWER MS VALLEY TO THE SOUTHEAST COAST. SFC LOW AMIDST VERY MOIST AIRMASS OVER NERN SC THIS MORNING IS FORECAST TO EDGE OFFSHORE AND MOVE TO THE OUTER BANKS BY EARLY TOMORROW. WEAK FRONTAL ZONE/WIND SHIFT IN THE WAKE OF THIS SYSTEM EXTENDS SWWD ACROSS GA/AL AND THEN RETURNS NWWD AS A WARM FRONT...DELINEATING THE ERN EDGE OF THE EML PLUME...FROM THE NCNTRL GULF COAST NWD ALONG T

sections.title: MID SOUTH TO LOWER MS VALLEY TO NERN GULF COAST
sections.text: CONVECTION/TSTMS DEVELOPED PER 13Z FORECAST ACROSS MUCH OF NRN FL INTO PARTS OF THE ERN FL PANHANDLE WHERE THE AIR MASS REMAINED QUITE MOIST /PW VALUES IN EXCESS OF 2 INCH/ AND SURFACE DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 70S. FORCING FOR ASCENT WITHIN THE CYCLONIC FLOW REGIME AND AHEAD A SRN GA SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL CONTINUE SUPPORT NEW TSTM DEVELOPMENT TRACKING SEWD ACROSS N FL...WHILE NEW STORMS ALSO FORM ALONG A NWD ADVANCING SEA BREEZE/OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES OVER THE ERN FL PANHANDLE. WEAK DEEP LAYER SHEAR WILL LIMIT STORM ORGANIZATION...BUT HIGH MOISTURE-LADEN AIR WILL SUPPORT HEAVY RAINFALL...WITH SOME POTENTIAL FOR LOCALLY STRONG WET MICROBURSTS. MEANWHILE...A GREATER SEVERE WEATHER THREAT CONTINUES TO BE FORECAST FARTHER W THROUGH NW ALONG THE TRAILING EXTENT OF THE SURFACE BOUNDARY/DIFFERENTIAL HEATING BOUNDARY EXTENDING FROM SRN AL NWWD THROUGH EAST CENTRAL TO NRN MS. STRONG SURFACE HEATING ALREADY WELL INTO TO THE 90S OVER THE LOWER MS VALLEY WILL SUPPORT VERY STRONG DESTABILIZATION ACROSS MUCH OF MS INTO SRN AL AND WRN FL PANHANDLE WITH MLCAPE OF 3000-4000 J/KG. INCREASING N/NWLY MIDLEVEL WINDS ACROSS THIS SLIGHT RISK AREA WILL ENHANCE BULK SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED TSTM CLUSTERS AND A FEW SU

sections.title: COASTAL PLAINS OF NERN SC AND NC TO NC OUTER BANKS
sections.text: REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY OVER NERN SC INDICATED AN AREA OF BROAD LOW LEVEL CIRCULATION CENTERED OVER HORRY COUNTY SC...WITH THIS CIRCULATION A SUB-SYNOPTIC LOW LOCATED ALONG A WIND SHIFT EXTENDING NEWD FROM THE PRIMARY LOW OVER SERN GA. THE NERN SC LOW WILL ACT TO ENHANCE LOW LEVEL SHEAR OVER NERN SC AND ERN NC AND...ANY WATERSPOUTS FORMING OFFSHORE COULD POSE A THREAT AS THEY MOVE TOWARD THE COAST WITHIN ELY LOW LEVEL FLOW ALONG THE TRACK OF THE SURFACE LOW FROM NERN SC TO THE NC COAST. SURFACE HEATING ALONG THE WRN EXTENT OF ONGOING TSTM CLUSTERS LOCATED MAINLY OFFSHORE THIS MORNING HAS ELIMINATED THE WEAK SURFACE BASED INHIBITION EVIDENT IN THE 12Z SOUNDINGS AT CHS...AND WILL ALLOW FOR ADDITIONAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT FROM ERN SC SWWD TO SRN GA. DESPITE THE LACK OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR SUFFICIENT FOR STORM ORGANIZATION...RICH MOISTURE /PW VALUES AROUND 2 INCH PER 12Z SOUNDINGS/...SURFACE BASED VORTICITY AND MODERATE INSTABILITY SUGGEST A SLIGHTLY GREATER CHANCE FOR DAMAGING WINDS OVER THESE AREAS LATER THIS AFTERNOON.

sections.title: CNTRL MT...PARTS OF THE NRN/CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: A SHORTWAVE UPPER TROUGH OVER THE PAC NW WILL CREST THE CNTRL CONUS RIDGE AND MOVE ACROSS SRN CANADA...WITH A GLANCING INFLUENCE ACROSS THE NRN ROCKIES CONTRIBUTING TO TSTM DEVELOPMENT OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN. MODERATE MIDLEVEL WLYS COULD RESULT IN A FEW TSTMS MOVING OFF THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND OVER THE HIGH PLAINS DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON AND EVENING...INTO A WELL-MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER WITH AN ATTENDANT THREAT FOR ISOLATED STRONG-SVR WIND GUSTS AND HAIL. ADDITIONALLY...A SFC LEE TROUGH WILL EXTEND SWD INTO THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS...WHILE A WEAK FRONT BECOMES POSITIONED FROM CNTRL MT SEWD TO NEAR THE NEB/SD BORDER BY THIS AFTERNOON...PROVIDING AN ADDITIONAL FOCUS FOR ISOLATED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT OVER PARTS OF ERN MT/WY...THE NEB PANHANDLE...AND N-CNTRL NEB. COVERAGE OF THE THREAT SHOULD REMAIN SPARSE OWING TO THE PRESENCE OF MIDLEVEL RIDGING AND WEAK DEEP-LAYER FORCING...SUFFICIENT TO MAINTAIN 5 PERCENT WIND/HAIL PROBABILITIES. ..CARBIN/PETERS/ROGERS.. 07/30/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE TSTMS ARE EXPECTED AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT MOVING ACROSS PARTS OF NRN WI AND INTO THE U.P. OF MI THROUGH LATE THIS AFTERNOON. A WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED AHEAD OF THIS DEVELOPING SEVERE WEATHER.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG SFC HEATING IS EVIDENT ACROSS WARM SECTOR OVER MUCH OF NRN WI AND SHOULD CONTINUE TO AID AIRMASS DESTABILIZATION AHEAD OF A WELL DEFINED SHORT WAVE TROUGH AND COLD FRONT DEVELOPING SEWD FROM NRN MN AND LAKE SUPERIOR INTO NWRN WI. LATEST TRENDS SUGGEST STORM INITIATION WILL BE LIKELY IN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO FROM LAKE SUPERIOR SRN SHORE TO AROUND THE WI/MI BORDER WHERE INHIBITION WILL LIKELY BE OVERCOME IN THE PRESENCE OF INCREASING SUPPORT FOR UPWARD MOTION AHEAD OF THE FRONT. GIVEN FEED OF STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES EVIDENT ON MPX MORNING SOUNDING...AND SUFFICIENT SHEAR PROVIDED BY 30-50KT MID LEVEL FLOW...RESULTING CONVECTION SHOULD BE WELL ORGANIZED WITH PERSISTENT UPDRAFTS CAPABLE OF BOTH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. EXPECT THE STORMS TO POSSIBLY CONSOLIDATE ALONG THE ADVANCING COLD FRONT LATER THIS AFTERNOON WITH WIND AND HAIL POTENTIAL CONTINUING ACROSS THE U.P. OF MI AND INTO PARTS OF ERN WI.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS SHOULD INCREASE IN COVERAGE NWWD FROM THE ONGOING ACTIVITY OVER THE WRN FL PANHANDLE AND SRN/SWRN AL. SOME UNCERTAINTY REMAINS WITH THE EXTENT OF OVERALL COVERAGE FOR STRONGER TO SEVERE STORMS ACROSS ERN/SRN MS INTO WRN/SRN AL THAT WOULD WARRANT WATCH ISSUANCE. PRIMARY SEVERE THREATS ACROSS THIS REGION WILL BE DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 18Z...REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED TSTMS...SOME STRONG TO SEVERE...HAD FORMED OVER PARTS OF THE WRN FL PANHANDLE INTO SRN AND SWRN AL. FARTHER NW INTO CENTRAL-N CENTRAL MS... VISIBLE IMAGERY INDICATED CU DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE NNWWD EXTENDING WARM FRONT/DIFFERENTIAL HEATING BOUNDARY FROM 30 WNW MEI TO 25 E GWO. 13Z/14Z RUNS OF THE HRRR AND 12Z 4 KM WRF-NSSL/NMM SUGGEST THIS INITIAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT WILL EXPAND IN COVERAGE ACROSS SRN AL...WRN FL PANHANDLE INTO SERN MS BEFORE MOVING OFFSHORE OR WEAKENING BETWEEN 31/00-02Z. ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT WAS ALSO FORECAST NNWWD INTO ERN MS. THIS LATTER TSTM DEVELOPMENT SHOULD POSE A GREATER SEVERE WEATHER THREAT AS IT WOULD MOVE INTO THE RESERVOIR OF MUCH STRONGER INSTABILITY /MLCAPE NOW RANGING FROM 3500-4000 J PER KG/ LOCATED OVER CENTRAL/SRN MS INTO SERN LA. STRONG SURFACE HEATING WITH THE RATHER MOIST AIR MASS ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA HAS RESULTED IN MLCAPE OF 2500-4000 J/KG THUS FAR. MEANWHILE...25-30 KT NLY MIDLEVEL WINDS SPREADING SWD TO THE GULF COAST ATOP W/NWLY LOW LEVEL WINDS ARE SUPPORTING AN INCREASE IN EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR FOR MULTICELL STORM MODE IN THE SHORT TERM OVER SRN AL AND THE WRN FL PANHANDLE. GIVEN THE AVAILABLE INSTABILITY/ SHEAR PARAMETER SPACE...WITH BULK SHEAR EXPECTED TO INCREASE ACROSS MS...AT LEAST ISOLATED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON WITH STRONG WINDS AND HAIL THE PRIMARY THREATS. IF RADAR/SATELLITE IMAGERY SUGGESTS WIDESPREAD TSTM DEVELOPMENT WITH NWWD EXTENT...THEN A WW WOULD BE NEEDED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORM DEVELOPMENT HAS BEEN SLOW TO OCCUR ACROSS THE WATCH AREA THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON. HOWEVER...THE CHANCE FOR SEVERE WEATHER AHEAD OF AN ADVANCING COLD FRONT OVER THE AREA REMAINS A CONCERN AS STRONGER UPDRAFTS ARE NOW OCCURRING NEAR THE WI/MI BORDER IN FLORENCE COUNTY WI AND DICKINSON COUNTY MI.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: DESPITE REMOVAL OF REMAINING CONVECTIVE INHIBITION ACROSS NRN WI AND THE CENTRAL PORTIONS OF THE U.P. OF MI...TSTM INITIATION HAS BEEN HINDERED AHEAD OF A WEAKLY CONVERGENT COLD FRONT SITUATED FROM LAKE SUPERIOR SWWD ACROSS WI. WITH TEMPERATURES NOW WELL INTO THE 80S F NORTH AND OVER 90 F IN THE SRN PORTION OF THE WATCH...EXPECT ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT TO OCCUR WITHIN THE RESULTING INSTABILITY AXIS AHEAD OF THE FRONT THROUGH LATE THIS AFTERNOON. RECENT DEVELOPMENT APPEARS TO BE DISCRETE IN NATURE AND COULD ACQUIRE SUPERCELL STRUCTURE GIVEN EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES IN EXCESS OF 30KT. THE THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL WILL EVOLVE WITH THESE STORMS. EVENTUALLY...STORMS SHOULD CONCENTRATE IN A MORE LINEAR FASHION ALONG THE ADVANCING FRONT WITH AN INCREASING CHANCE FOR DAMAGING WINDS IF A SQUALL LINE EVOLVES INTO THE EARLY EVENING. ..CARBIN.. 07/30/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLD SEVERE WIND GUST THREAT WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP AND MOVE EWD INTO PARTS OF ERN CO THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SCTD STORMS HAVE DEVELOPED DURING THE PAST FEW HOURS AND MORE RECENTLY MOVED EWD INTO THE ADJACENT HIGH PLAINS. THESE STORMS ARE ROUNDING THE NRN PERIPHERY OF THE S-CNTRL U.S. ANTICYCLONE AND ARE WITHIN A BELT OF MODESTLY STRONG WLY FLOW /35 KTS AT 6 KM AGL/ PER THE PLT VWP. WEAK ELY LOW LEVEL COMPONENT TO THE FLOW HAS MAINTAINED 50-55 DEG F DEWPOINTS WITH TEMPS RISING INTO THE 90S DOWNSTREAM OF THE ONGOING STORMS. MODIFYING THE 12Z DNR RAOB FOR A 90 TEMP AND 50 DEWPOINT YIELDS 1200 J/KG SBCAPE ATOP A DRY ADIABATIC LAPSE RATE FROM THE SURFACE-600 MB LEVEL. AS SUCH...APPRECIABLE PW /AROUND 1 INCH/ AND ADEQUATE FLOW FOR SOME STORM ORGANIZATION ALONG WITH STORM MERGERS/COLD POOL CONSOLIDATION WILL PROBABLY PROMOTE UPSCALE GROWTH INTO 1 OR MORE SMALL LINEAR CLUSTERS CAPABLE OF ISOLD SEVERE WIND GUSTS AS THEY MOVE EWD DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON INTO THE EVENING HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR THUNDERSTORM INTENSIFICATION FROM SERN MO INTO NERN AR. ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL MAY BECOME POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CUMULUS HAS BEEN INCREASING AND A COUPLE OF THUNDERSTORMS HAVE DEVELOPED OVER SERN MO INTO NERN AR IN VICINITY OF A SFC LOW AND QUASISTATIONARY FRONT THAT EXTENDS FROM SRN KS INTO SRN MO...NERN AR AND NWRN MS. DEEP MIXING IN WARM SECTOR HAS RESULTED IN 100S TEMPERATURES AND DEWPOINTS IN THE 50S. THE SFC LAYER IS SOMEWHAT COOLER EAST OF THE FRONT WITH LOW-MID 90S TEMPERATURES AND LOW 70S DEWPOINTS SUPPORTING MLCAPE FROM 2000-2500 J/KG. CAPPING INVERSION AROUND 850 MB HAS LIMITED SFC BASED DEVELOPMENT SO FAR...AND FORCING THROUGH A DEEP LAYER IS RELATIVELY WEAK. TRENDS IN SATELLITE AND RADAR DATA SUGGEST THE CAP IS BEGINNING TO WEAKEN...SUPPORTING RECENT CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT. VEERING WIND PROFILES WITH 30-35 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR WILL PROMOTE ORGANIZED MULTICELLS AND MARGINAL SUPERCELL STRUCTURES AS STORMS MOVE SEWD ALONG THE BOUNDARY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL WILL PERSIST NEXT HOUR OR SO FROM EXTREME NERN WI INTO THE CNTRL AND ERN UPPER PENINSULA OF MI. ACTIVITY WILL SOON BEGIN TO CROSS LAKE MI. UNLESS THE STORMS MAINTAIN ORGANIZATION AND INTENSITY...A WW WILL PROBABLY NOT BE NEEDED FOR LOWER MI.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS CONTINUE ALONG AND JUST AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT FROM EXTREME NERN WI INTO THE ERN PENINSULA OF UPPER MI AND IS APPROACHING THE NWRN SHORE OF LAKE MI. INSTABILITY IS LIMITED FARTHER DOWNSTREAM OVER THE NRN PART OF LOWER MI WHERE DEWPOINTS ARE ONLY IN THE LOWER 60S AND TEMPERATURES IN THE LOW 80S. THE SFC LAYER WILL CONTINUE TO STABILIZE WITH ONSET OF NOCTURNAL COOLING. HOWEVER...MODEST 850 MB MOISTURE ADVECTION MAY CONTRIBUTE TO SOME DESTABILIZATION ABOVE THE SFC. CURRENT THINKING IS THAT STORMS WILL POSE A SEVERE THREAT FROM ERN WI INTO ERN LOWER MI THROUGH AT LEAST 00Z...BUT WILL BEGIN TO WEAKEN AS THEY CROSS THE LAKE. ..DIAL.. 07/30/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL LIKELY CONTINUE ACROSS ERN CO AND INTO NWRN KS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS HAVE BECOME FAVORABLE FOR SEVERE STORMS AND A WATCH ISSUANCE WILL BE COORDINATED BETWEEN THE SPC AND THE AFFECTED LOCAL NATIONAL WEATHER SERVICE OFFICES SHORTLY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS WILL LIKELY CONTINUE DEVELOPING SEWD THROUGH ERN MS AND WRN THROUGH CNTRL AL INTO THE EARLY MORNING. A FEW STORMS MAY POSE A THREAT FOR ISOLATED STRONG TO DAMAGING WIND. CURRENTLY ONLY ONE SEVERE STORM EXISTS OVER EXTREME NERN MS. HOWEVER...IF TRENDS BEGIN TO INDICATE THAT ADDITIONAL STORMS ARE INTENSIFYING...A WW MIGHT BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATE THIS EVENING A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT EXTENDS FROM CNTRL MS NWWD THROUGH NRN AR INTO SRN KS. A LARGE AREA OF MOSTLY ELEVATED STORMS PERSISTS WITHIN ZONE OF ISENTROPIC ASCENT ON THE COOL SIDE OF THIS BOUNDARY ACROSS WRN AND MIDDLE TN. HOWEVER...STORMS APPEAR TO BE FORWARD PROPAGATING ALONG LEADING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ACROSS NRN MS AND THIS ACTIVITY WILL LIKELY CONTINUE SEWD ALONG INSTABILITY GRADIENT. MODEST INFLOW FROM THE UNSTABLE WARM SECTOR MIGHT SUPPORT INTENSIFICATION OF STORMS FARTHER WEST ALONG THE SWD MOVING BOUNDARY...BUT AN INCREASE IN CONVECTIVE INHIBITION RESULTING FROM NOCTURNAL COOLING MIGHT SERVE AS A LIMITING FACTOR. AREA WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED...AND ANY WW ISSUANCE WILL ULTIMATELY DEPEND ON CONVECTIVE TRENDS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT MAY CONTINUE FOR A FEW MORE HOURS ACROSS LOWER MI EXTENDING WWD INTO SE WI AND NE IL. WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. THE SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO BE TOO MARGINAL TO WARRANT WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A NEARLY CONTINUOUS LINE OF STORMS EXTENDS FROM CNTRL LOWER MI WWD INTO NE IL JUST AHEAD OF A SHORTWAVE TROUGH EVIDENT ON WATER VAPOR IMAGERY. LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS PROVIDING SUPPORT FOR THE LINE IN SPITE OF A CAPPING INVERSION THAT IS LIKELY MAKING THE CONVECTION ELEVATED. THE LINE IS LOCATED ON THE ERN EDGE OF MODERATE INSTABILITY WHERE MLCAPE VALUES VARY FROM LESS THAN 500 J/KG IN CNTRL LOWER MI TO AROUND 1500 J/KG IN SERN WI. IN ADDITION TO THE INSTABILITY...WSR-88D VWPS IN THE VICINITY OF THE LINE SHOW 30 TO 40 KT OF DEEP LAYER SHEAR. THIS COMBINED WITH MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AROUND 7.5 C/KM SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR A SEVERE THREAT DURING THE OVERNIGHT PERIOD. THE LINE IS MOVING SSEWD AT AROUND 30 KT AND APPEARS TO HAVE A SOMEWHAT ORGANIZED COLD POOL. FOR THIS REASON...A WIND DAMAGE THREAT SHOULD PERSIST FOR A FEW MORE HOURS. DUE TO THE STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...HAIL MAY ALSO OCCUR WITH THE STRONGER CORES EMBEDDED IN THE LINE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DEVELOPMENT OF A SMALL MCS APPEARS LIKELY ACROSS NW/CENTRAL AL THE NEXT FEW HOURS...BUT AN APPROACHING OUTFLOW FROM THE S ADDS UNCERTAINTY TO THE LONGER-TERM THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS/HAIL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTION HAS BEEN INCREASING IN COVERAGE ACROSS NW/CENTRAL AL THE PAST 1-2 HOURS IN A ZONE OF LOW-LEVEL WAA FROM THE W...ON THE NE EDGE OF A RESERVOIR OF MODERATE-STRONG INSTABILITY EXTENDING EWD FROM CENTRAL MS. LARGE SCALE SUPPORT FOR STORM DEVELOPMENT WILL PERSIST WITH A WEAK WLY LLJ AND THE APPROACH OF A MIDLEVEL TROUGH FROM THE NNW...AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 30-35 KT WILL SUPPORT ORGANIZED STORMS/CLUSTERS. HOWEVER...OUTFLOW FROM EARLIER CONVECTION ACROSS SE AL IS ADVANCING NWD/NNWWD ACROSS CENTRAL AL AND WILL ENCOUNTER THE DEVELOPING STORMS IN THE NEXT HOUR NEAR BHM...AND IN THE NEXT 2-3 HOURS FARTHER W INTO W CENTRAL AL. A SHORT-TERM INCREASE IN STORM INTENSITY MAY OCCUR WITH THE OUTFLOW/STORM MERGERS...BUT A COOLER/MORE STABLE AIR MASS TO THE S OF THE BOUNDARY MAY LIMIT THE SEWD EXTENT OF THE DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL RISK. GIVEN THE SOMEWHAT CONFINED EXTENT OF THE SEVERE THREAT IN AL...THE NEED FOR A WATCH IS UNCLEAR...BUT THIS AREA WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED. ..THOMPSON.. 07/31/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A MARGINAL SEVERE THREAT SHOULD CONTINUE FOR AWHILE LONGER IN WW 542 BUT THE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY DECREASE EARLY THIS MORNING. ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE WOULD LIKELY BE THE PRIMARY THREAT. IF THE DOWNTREND IN CONVECTIVE INTENSITY CONTINUES...THEN WW 542 COULD BE CANCELLED EARLY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN MCS ONGOING ACROSS CNTRL AND SRN AL WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO MOVE SSEWD EARLY THIS MORNING. MESOANALYSIS CURRENTLY ESTIMATES MLCAPE VALUES ACROSS THE WATCH AREA GENERALLY AT OR BELOW 500 J/KG. THIS COMBINED WITH COOLING SFC TEMPS DUE TO THE LARGE EXPANSE OF OUTFLOW PRESENT ACROSS SCNTRL AL HAS MADE THE CONVECTIVE ENVIRONMENT LESS CONDUCIVE FOR SEVERE STORMS. DUE TO THIS...THE MARGINAL WIND DAMAGE THREAT ASSOCIATED WITH THE STRONGER CELLS EMBEDDED IN THE MCS IS LIKELY TO DECREASE OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR SO. ..BROYLES.. 07/31/2012
